explanation: The theorem says the library's barycentric subdivision operator on singular chains (`singularSubdivision`, built on the library's `SingularChainFinsupp`, `singularFinsuppMap` and `realizeAffineChain`) commutes with pushforward along a continuous map. All of that content sits in the library's own definitions. The proof only uses induction on finsupps and the library's own lemmas. I grepped Mathlib's AlgebraicTopology directory for "subdivision". The only hits are about subdivision of simplicial sets (SimplicialSet/Subdivision.lean, Nonsingular.lean, AnodyneExtensions), which is unrelated. Mathlib has no barycentric subdivision of singular chains, so it has no naturality result for one.
